## Flags

Flag images (Flags app) come from [flag-icons](https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons) 7.5.0 (MIT licence; the flag designs themselves are public domain). `scripts/copy-flags.mjs` copies the 64 SVGs the app uses into `public/flags/4x3/` on install/build.

Map geometry (Maps, Flags, Landmarks) is from [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) (public domain) via world-atlas / us-atlas.
